presets.name: Conservative dissolved tracer (chloride approximation)
presets.description: Dissolved conservative reference for dilution, connectivity and residence time. All chemical reactions disabled by construction. Chloride is only an approximation; evaporative concentration must come from water balance, and salinity-density coupling is not represented.

provenance.note: A conservative baseline is a modeling choice, not a chloride rate measured at Angkor.

presets.name: Atrazine (EPA property seed; kinetics unconfigured)
presets.description: Modern hypothetical organic-contaminant example, not evidence of atrazine at medieval or present-day Angkor. EPA legacy factsheet reports mean Koc from four soils; use only as an uncertain starting property. All processes remain disabled until site-specific coefficients and switches are supplied.

koc_l_kg_oc.source_locator: Environmental Fate and Chemical/Physical Properties, PDF pages 2-3
koc_l_kg_oc.conditions: Average for four soils; not Angkor sediment. Legacy fact sheet does not identify the individual soils or uncertainty interval.
koc_l_kg_oc.uncertainty: Unknown; test sensitivity and obtain original study or local sediment measurements before calibration.

provenance.note: Photolysis depends strongly on spectrum and sensitizers; published laboratory values are not copied into sunlight kinetics. Soil hydrolysis descriptions are not assigned to canal-water hydrolysis.

required_site_inputs: Bed organic carbon fraction and active dry solids
Condition-specific water and bed parent-transformation rates
Light spectrum, shading, depth and turbidity for photolysis
Temperature, pH and dissolved oxygen observations

presets.name: User-defined dissolved chemical
presets.description: Empty configuration for measured site-specific chemical properties. All processes disabled; this is a conservative calculation until explicitly configured, not a claim that an arbitrary chemical is persistent.

provenance.note: Search by chemical identity and export property details. Keep each measurement or prediction, units, method, temperature, pH, study and uncertainty; no live database lookup has populated these coefficients.

required_site_inputs: Measured fate properties or labeled screening predictions
Site hydraulic, sediment, light and loading data

epa_resources.name: WASP
epa_resources.use: Established coupled surface-water water-quality modeling and hydrodynamic linkage; this code does not reproduce WASP.

epa_resources.name: EPI Suite
epa_resources.use: Screening predictions, not measurements. EPA advises acceptable measured properties take precedence. WVOLWIN river/lake estimates embed assumed depth and wind conditions.

epa_resources.name: CompTox property details
epa_resources.use: Chemical identities and measured or predicted environmental fate/transport properties. Preserve the provenance of each value.

epa_resources.name: ECOTOX
epa_resources.use: Effects/hazard data for ecological comparisons; toxicity endpoints do not supply transport or degradation rates.

epa_resources.name: EXAMS overview
epa_resources.use: Historical EPA organic chemical exposure/fate modeling framework; environmental, chemical and loading data are all required.
